approval.basis: User continued the female day editorial product breakdown and GitHub upload workflow with minimal looks.

copy.captionKo: 카멜과 브라운 위로, 길게 이어지는 레드.
copy.captionEn: A long line of red over camel and brown.
copy.captionDe: Eine lange rote Linie über Camel und Braun.
copy.introKo: 카멜 크롭 재킷과 브라운 턴업 팬츠를 차콜 니트로 연결해요. 얇은 레드 스카프를 길게 두르고 다크 브라운 숄더백과 앵클부츠로 톤을 정리해요.
copy.introEn: Link a cropped camel jacket and brown turn-up trousers with charcoal knit. Let a lightweight red scarf fall long, then ground the palette with a dark brown bag and ankle boots.
copy.introDe: Verbinde eine kurze camelfarbene Jacke und braune Umschlaghosen durch anthrazitfarbenen Strick. Lasse einen leichten roten Schal lang fallen und ergänze eine dunkelbraune Tasche sowie Ankle-Boots.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 카멜 크롭 재킷 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: camel tan wool-look cropped tailored jacket, spread notched collar, two dark brown front buttons, boxy straight body, plain straight sleeves

products.descriptionKo: 아우터 안에서 니트의 표면을 보여줘요. 밑단을 정돈해 와이드 하의의 여유를 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Show the knit texture beneath the jacket and keep the hem neat above the wide trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige die Strickstruktur unter der Jacke und ordne den Saum über der weiten Hose.
products.altKo: 차콜 멜란지 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark charcoal heather crewneck long-sleeve sweater, fuzzy fine knit, ribbed cuffs projecting beneath camel jacket, hidden torso conservative

products.descriptionKo: 넉넉한 통을 접거나 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 상의 밑단을 정돈해 하의의 실루엣을 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the generous legs fall naturally and keep the top hem neat so the trouser shape stays visible.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die weiten Beine natürlich fallen und ordne das Oberteil, damit die Form der Hose sichtbar bleibt.
products.altKo: 브라운 턴업 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: chocolate brown tailored straight trousers with front pleats, thin belt loops, dark waist button and broad turned-up ankle hems as visible over ankle boot, hidden back conservative

products.descriptionKo: 얇은 레드 스카프를 목에 한 번 두르고 끝을 길게 남겨요. 두껍게 말기보다 가벼운 선으로 보여줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Wrap the lightweight red scarf once, leaving long ends rather than building a bulky knot.
products.descriptionDe: Lege den leichten roten Schal einmal um den Hals und lasse lange Enden statt eines dicken Knotens stehen.
products.altKo: 레드 라이트 스카프 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE vivid true red thin soft lightweight long scarf with fine short fringed/tasselled ends, flowing light fabric rather than bulky chunky wool, full scarf laid neatly

products.descriptionKo: 몸 가까이 걸쳐 실루엣을 간결하게 정리해요. 스트랩은 겉옷 위에서 자연스럽게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Carry close to the body for a clean silhouette, letting the strap sit naturally over the outer layer.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Tasche nah am Körper und lasse den Riemen natürlich über der äußeren Lage liegen.
products.altKo: 다크 브라운 숄더백 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE dark brown smooth leather-look medium shoulder bag with long slim strap, softly structured narrow trapezoid/rounded rectangular body visible at side, conservative hidden rear

products.descriptionKo: 턴업 밑단을 부츠 샤프트 위에 자연스럽게 두어요. 팬츠와 부츠의 짙은 브라운을 연결해요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the turn-up hem sit naturally above the boot shaft, linking the dark browns.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse den Umschlag natürlich über dem Stiefelschaft sitzen und verbinde die dunklen Brauntöne.
products.altKo: 브라운 앵클부츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair dark chocolate brown smooth leather-look ankle boots, almond toes, low block heels, ankle-height shafts, minimal seams and conservative concealed closure. BOOT COMPOSITION: stand BOTH boots upright on their soles, aligned and turned together slightly for clean THREE-QUARTER view showing toes sides shafts and full silhouette, modest stagger only, NOT overhead and NOT lying down.

products.descriptionKo: 니트 위로 작은 펜던트만 드러내요. 가는 체인으로 목선의 레이어를 가볍게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the small pendant sit over the knit, keeping the neckline light with a fine chain.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse den kleinen Anhänger über dem Strick liegen und halte den Ausschnitt mit einer feinen Kette leicht.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 코인 네크리스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE delicate fine gold-tone necklace with small plain round coin pendant visible on charcoal sweater, full chain neat oval

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 미니 골드 후프 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair small thin gold-tone hoop earrings based on visible ear, no extra jewelry

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, linings, waistbands, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Jewelry backs, posts and clasps are inferred; actual metal composition is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition or performance.
Exact actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, excluded from outfit products.
Socks are hidden by boots and were not generated.
